clusters.label: Library Wi-Fi drops repeatedly in the afternoon.

complaints.transcript: The Wi-Fi in the library keeps dropping every afternoon and nobody seems to fix it.
Library internet is unusable after lunch, my video calls keep cutting out.
Wi-Fi on the second floor of the library disconnects every few minutes.

clusters.label: Canteen lunch queues are long because too few counters are open.

complaints.transcript: The canteen queue at lunch is insane, only two counters are open.
I wait 25 minutes for lunch every day at the canteen.
